thread:
alex: Hey folks, hitting a blocker on the Node quickstart. My curl and SDK calls both fail with a weird timeout then 401. quickstart steps: set REDWOOD_API_KEY, npm i @redwood/inference, run sample.

alex: Error from node: 
```
Error: Request failed with status code 401
 at createError (...)
 at settle (...)
```

alex: Also noticed log line: \"billing: workspace suspended - billing required\" which confused me because I assumed trial workspaces could hit the hosted API.
jordan: can you paste the exact curl and the Node snippet?
alex: curl: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-alpha\",\"input\":\"hi\"}'`
alex: node: 
```
const { Redwood } = require('@redwood/inference');
const client = new Redwood(process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY);
const res = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-alpha', input: 'hello' });
console.log(res);
```
jordan: that looks right. 401 + billing hint means the workspace is blocked until billing is linked. are you using a Google-managed org account? we added a policy to require billing for org-owned workspaces recently.
maya: run `redwood workspace status` in the CLI to see billing state.
alex: ran it -> `workspace: rdx-dev (id: ws_123) status: active trial expires: 2026-04-02 billing: not configured`
alex: ok that explains it. UX note: the quickstart flow didn't warn me that billing would be required before the first API call.
jordan: agreed. filing a small fix to surface billing state during `npx redwood quickstart`. opened issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex/issues/412
billing-bot: Automated message: Workspace ws_123 flagged as \"billing_required\". To enable hosted API, link a billing method in Console -> Billing.
alex: after linking a card in Console my curl succeeded immediately. first successful call! :tada:
alex: one more odd thing: Node SDK timed out on retry attempt 1 and then returned 401 instead of retrying on transient 5xx. any guidance on recommended retry config?
jordan: SDK defaults are conservative; we may need to adjust retry logic to treat certain 401s that include billing hints as terminal. can you run with `DEBUG=redwood:* node app.js` and paste logs?
alex: will add logs to the GH issue. thanks for the quick help.
devex-bot: Note: proposed PR to add billing check in `npx redwood quickstart` and improve CLI messaging when workspace billing blocks API calls.
maya: also adding a line to quickstart README about "billing gating" and a troubleshooting section for 401s during onboarding.
alex: thanks all, unblocked and first call succeeded. saved me from a tomato can of frustration :slightly_smiling_face:
